children: BiomX announced a one-for-ten reverse stock split of its common stock, reducing outstanding shares to ~2.7 million and authorized shares to 150,000,000.
Board fixed a 1-for-10 reverse split effective 12:01 a.m. ET on September 9, 2026; trading to be split-adjusted on NYSE American that day.
Authorized common shares to be reduced from 750,000,000 to 150,000,000 via Certificate of Amendment filed in Delaware.
Outstanding shares will convert from ~26.7 million to ~2.7 million; fractional shares rounded up to next whole share.
Proportionate adjustments to warrants, convertible instruments and equity awards; Continental Stock Transfer acting as exchange agent.
